newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes mixed as index dips.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes mixed as index dips.

text.p: Ghanaian shares closed mixed on Wednesday in moderate volume, with two equities advancing and an equal number declining.
The GSE All-Share Index dipped 0.46 points to settle at 356.68 points, down from its previous 357.14 points.
Shares traded totalled 143,640, with offers well above bids at 2,965,550 to 528,950.
Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd gained 190 cedis to close at 20,700 cedis and Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd added 100 cedis to 5,200.
Standard Chartered Bank lost 100 cedis to 4,900 cedis while Fan Milk Ltd dropped 14 cedis to 390 cedis.
